newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Feb 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Feb 27.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- President Kim Young-sam is expected to press forward with a major reshuffling of the cabinet, top government officials, and members of the ruling party in March.
- Ruling and opposition camp lawmakers on Wednesday grilled the administration over the collapse of Hanbo Steel during a question and answer session in the National Assembly.
- A foreign ministry official on Wednesday denied reports that the United States has been asked to handle the defection of top North Korean ideologue, Hwang Jang-yop.
- The ruling New Korea Party during a meeting on Wednesday agreed to remove an article in the new labour law that allows worker lay offs.
